metadata.title: Max Planck — a Bear's Notes mini-bio
metadata.structure: Bear (voice clone) narrates throughout. Visuals ALTERNATE: render:clip = full-frame Higgsfield footage (the scientist Soul-ID, an application, or a phenomenon); render:manim = clean dark cinematic card (title / equation / date). Audio-first: each beat's visual = its narration length. Clip beats show a labeled placeholder until real footage is composited in (composite_clips.py).

beats.narration_text: Max Planck didn't set out to start a revolution.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Max Planck didn't set out to start a revolution.
beats.shot: Soul-ID Max Planck — period portrait, slow push-in, dim study, round glasses.
beats.higgsfield_prompt: Cinematic period portrait of an early-20th-century German physicist, round wire-rimmed glasses, dark three-piece suit, seated at a wooden desk in a dim university study with papers and an oil lamp, warm low-key Rembrandt lighting, shallow depth of field, faint dust drifting in the light, slow subtle push-in, 1900s documentary film grain, muted sepia-grey palette, contemplative mood, 5 seconds, no text, no captions

beats.narration_text: A careful German physicist, he just wanted to explain the glow of hot objects.
beats.tts_normalized_text: A careful German physicist, he just wanted to explain the glow of hot objects.

beats.narration_text: Classical physics said that glow should blast out endless ultraviolet.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Classical physics said that glow should blast out endless ultraviolet.
beats.shot: Phenomenon — a furnace / molten metal glowing white-hot, heat shimmer.
beats.higgsfield_prompt: Extreme close-up of an open industrial furnace door, molten white-hot metal glowing at its core, intense radiant heat shimmer distorting the air, a few sparks drifting upward, deep blacks surrounding a blinding hot center, slow dolly-in, high-contrast cinematic, anamorphic, 5 seconds, no text, no people

beats.narration_text: Planck's fix: energy comes in discrete chunks — E equals h times frequency.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Planck's fix: energy comes in discrete chunks — E equals h times frequency.

beats.narration_text: That one idea underlies every transistor and laser in your pocket.
beats.tts_normalized_text: That one idea underlies every transistor and laser in your pocket.
beats.shot: Application — extreme macro of a silicon chip / wafer, probes, blue light.
beats.higgsfield_prompt: Extreme macro of a silicon semiconductor wafer rotating slowly, mirror-like surface with rainbow diffraction, fine etched circuitry and microscopic transistor arrays, cool blue and cyan light, clean high-tech laboratory, shallow rack focus drifting across the surface, cinematic, 5 seconds, no text, no people

beats.narration_text: It won him the Nobel Prize in nineteen-eighteen, and opened the quantum age.
beats.tts_normalized_text: It won him the Nobel Prize in nineteen eighteen, and opened the quantum age.

beats.narration_text: Max Planck — the reluctant father of the quantum, who never quite embraced the strange new world he had opened, yet changed physics forever.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Max Planck, the reluctant father of the quantum, who never quite embraced the strange new world he had opened, yet changed physics forever.
beats.shot: Soul-ID Max Planck — closing portrait, faint smile, fade to dark.
beats.higgsfield_prompt: Cinematic period portrait of the same early-20th-century German physicist, round wire-rimmed glasses, dark suit, calm and resolved with a faint knowing smile, soft key light slowly dimming, dark background, very slow push-in settling into stillness, gentle fade toward darkness at the very end, 1900s film look, muted palette, 5 seconds, no text
